title: C: Word Frequency Counter
description: Count the frequency of each word in a string and print the results.

steps.title: Tokenize and Count
steps.description: Declare `char str[] = "the cat and the hat and the dog"`. Tokenize by spaces and count word frequencies. Print each word and its count.
hints: Store words and counts in parallel arrays.
Print `word: count` for each unique word.
